C53476.observed: Re-measured at the moment of raising, on build v26.36.8-d146c39. One search for 'ZZ': the All tab reads All (111) while every tab for a single record type is correct and stops at 20 - Work orders (20), Customers (20), Assets (20), Parts (20), Vendors (11), Part sales (9), Purchase orders (6), Vendor invoices (5). 20+20+20+20+11+9+6+5 = 111, so the All figure is the per-type figures added together. A second search for 'ZZAUTOTEST' behaves the same way: All (61), which is 20+14+9+4+3+3+4+4. The same uncapped number is also read out to screen-reader users; that text is not visible on the screen. The requirement says no count in the box reads higher than 20, the tab included.
